clauses.text: Saying My IYAKKI starts Talk, and the red sign shows while the microphone is open

steps.do: Settings, Voice: press M to turn My IYAKKI on (a model must be in the data folder). Sign in and say 'My IYAKKI' from about 1 to 3 metres several times, and also say ordinary sentences.
steps.expect: A red sign shows on every screen while the microphone is open. Talk starts when the phrase is said. A click on the sign switches it off.
